sourceRoot: Directory containing index.ts, config.ts, tokens.css, components.css and ai/. All paths in this registry resolve from that directory; preserve ai/ when relocating it.

fields.name: radius
fields.note: Pixels. No runtime validation/clamp; use a finite nonnegative value. 0–16 is the workbench range, not a type/API restriction.

fields.name: reducedMotion
fields.note: true additionally reduces motion; false never overrides OS prefers-reduced-motion.

fields.name: numerals
fields.note: Digits for Arabic text: arab = Arabic-Indic (٠١٢), latn = Western (012). Every component number/date formatter follows it through numberLocale(config, language); English always formats as en. Caller-supplied copy and explicit Intl locale props are unchanged.

components.purpose: Start any request from the page you are on, with the right records attached: a greeting, a text area with chips for the attached records, a tools row (attach, the @ picker, the mode menu, dictate, send), suggestions from the current page and a list of recent tasks.

props.name: value
props.note: The draft, owned by the host.

props.name: onSubmit
props.note: Enter or Send hands over the draft exactly as written and a copy of the attached records. A rejected promise keeps the draft and shows the reason as text under the entry, only while the text still equals the failed draft. While the promise is pending the text area is read-only, send shows progress, a repeat is blocked and the suggestions are disabled.

props.name: context
props.note: The records attached to the request, shown as chips above the text area. ContextItem is { id, label, kind?, icon? }.

props.name: onRemoveContext
props.note: Gives each chip a remove button. Backspace in an empty text area never removes a chip.

props.name: onAttach
props.note: Shows the attach button. An intent only: the pattern uploads nothing.

props.name: onVoice
props.note: Shows the dictate button. An intent only: the pattern recognizes no speech.

props.name: mentionOptions
props.note: The records "@" offers. Typing @ at the start of the text or after a space, or pressing the @ button, opens a listbox of the ones not yet attached whose labels hold what follows the @. The text area becomes the combobox: it keeps focus and owns aria-expanded, aria-controls, aria-autocomplete="list" and aria-activedescendant. ArrowDown and ArrowUp move, Enter chooses, Escape closes the picker and goes no further. Keys from an input method never move or choose, and text that is still being composed never opens it (an open picker keeps filtering as the word is composed).

props.name: onAddContext
props.note: Called with the chosen record's id; the host adds it to context. The "@word" is removed from the draft through onValueChange.

props.name: onMention
props.note: Used when mentionOptions is absent, so the host opens its own picker: each change to the @ word calls it with what follows the @, and the @ button calls it with an empty string.

props.name: modes
props.note: The modes, as radio items with descriptions in the mode menu. ModeOption is { id, label, description? }. The menu shows when modes or models is given.

props.name: mode
props.note: The current mode's id.

props.name: onModeChange
props.note: Called when a different mode is chosen; the host sets mode.

props.name: models
props.note: Explicit models, as a second radio section of the same menu. An unavailable model shows disabled with its reason.

props.name: model
props.note: The current model's id.

props.name: contextUsage
props.note: The existing ContextMeter data. A ring beside the mode shows how much is used, in the meter's tones from its thresholds, and the menu ends with a bar and «السياق المستخدم ٣٢٪ · سجلّان مرفقان», whose count agrees in Arabic.

props.name: suggestions
props.type: readonly { id: string; label: string; prompt?: string; icon?: ReactNode }[]
props.note: Suggestions from the current page. They stay while the person types (PromptBar hides them) and are disabled while submitting.

props.name: onSuggestion
props.note: Called with the chosen suggestion's id; the host fills the draft with its prompt or label, or sends.

props.name: recent
props.type: readonly { id: string; title: string; status: StatusPillState; time: ReactNode }[]
props.note: Recent tasks, each with a status pill and a relative time the host writes.

props.name: greeting
props.note: The small line above the question.

props.name: title
props.note: The question; «ماذا نُنجز اليوم؟» by default.

props.name: disabled
props.note: Turns off the text area, the tools, the chips' remove buttons and the suggestions.

props.name: disabledReason
props.note: Why the assistant cannot take a request, as a line under the entry that the text area is described by.

props.name: modeMenuOpen
props.note: Controls the mode menu; pair it with onModeMenuOpenChange.

props.name: headingLevel
props.note: The question's level; the recent list's is one lower.

props.name: labels
props.note: Replaces any built-in text; contextStatus(status) is the region's sentence when the ring crosses a threshold.

props.name: announcement
props.note: Speak context additions, removals and threshold crossings by default. Set off when the host owns announcements; muted context changes are not replayed when announcements resume.

props.name: appearance
props.note: card sits on a tray with the field on paper; plain drops the tray and lives on its host's paper, keeping the field's hairline.

components.state: The host owns the draft, the attached records, the mode and the model. The pattern keeps only what the moment needs: the @ word at the caret, which option is active and whether a submission is pending. It never runs a request: onSubmit hands the draft and the records to the host.
accessibility: A section labelled by the question (a hidden heading when there is no greeting). One polite region says when a record joins or leaves the host's context: «أُضيف إلى السياق: INV-1043». It speaks one record joining or leaving, never the context the pattern mounts with and never a reset of several records at once. It also says «السياق: يقترب من الامتلاء» once each time the ring's status word changes, as ContextMeter's region does, never at mount. A failed send is announced and shown by the entry's own status. Set announcement="off" when the host owns context announcements; muted changes are not replayed.

The @ picker is a standard combobox on the text area: focus never leaves it, aria-activedescendant names the active option, and Escape closes the picker, not the page. A held Enter acts once. Keys from an input method (composition events, isComposing and keyCode 229) never choose, move or send.

The mode menu is a Radix menu of radio items: arrows move, Escape closes it and returns focus to the button, Tab closes it. The button's name is «الوضع: تلقائي» and it is described by «السياق المستخدم ٣٢٪».
When a change removes the focused control (a chip's remove button), focus moves to the section.
limitations: No model call, upload, speech recognition or transport: attach and dictate are intents. The listbox is anchored to the whole entry, not to the caret, which cannot be measured reliably in right-to-left text, so when it flips it lands above the draft.
Records already in context are not offered again. The @ word ends at a space, so the query is one word. Digits follow config.numerals; the percent is formatted without direction marks.
components.alternative: Use ChatComposer for a reply inside a conversation, PromptBar for a compact prompt with suggestions, and Input for plain search with no assistant.

components.purpose: Answer a question and show where each claim came from: the thinking while it happens, the answer with numbered citation chips that preview their source, follow-up questions, a rating, and the sources with the time it took.

props.name: status
props.note: Host-owned. Thinking opens the panel and offers Stop; writing folds the panel to «فكّر لمدة ٦ث» and streams the words; completed adds the follow-ups, the rating and the meta; failed keeps the partial answer with the error and Try again; stopped keeps it with «أُوقفت الإجابة» and Regenerate. A stop or a failure before a word was written also stops the thinking panel, which reads «أُوقف بعد ٦ث» or «تعثّر بعد ٦ث» with its thread still instead of closed; once words were written it reads «فكّر لمدة ٦ث».

props.name: question
props.note: The question, as the section's heading and a bubble at the inline end. Leave it out when a conversation already shows it; the section is then named «إجابة موثّقة».

props.name: content
props.note: Markdown, the whole text so far. A [n] marker names a source's number and becomes a citation chip, written in ASCII, Arabic-Indic or Persian digits; [n, m] or [n، m] cites several, as adjacent chips. A marker with no source for any of its numbers, or inside code, stays text. Links in it pass through sourceHref.

props.name: sources
props.note: The sources the answer cites. Their count and the answer's duration make the meta; the count is the button that opens the list.

props.name: thinking
props.type: { elapsed: number; searched: readonly SourceReference[]; steps?: readonly { id: string; label: string; state: "pending" | "running" | "completed" }[] }
props.note: What the search covered, for the thinking panel. Seconds, the sources found so far (the first three show as chips, and a button shows the rest) and the steps. Without it there is no panel.

props.name: thinkingOpen
props.note: Controls the panel; pair it with onThinkingOpenChange. Without it the panel is open while thinking and folds when the status leaves thinking.

props.name: followUps
props.note: Shown as a list of buttons once the answer is completed, and only with onFollowUp.

props.name: feedback
props.note: The rating, host-owned. The bar shows when onFeedbackChange, onCopy or onRegenerate exists.

props.name: reason
props.note: The reason picked for a "down" rating: inaccurate, wrong-source, too-long or outdated.

props.name: onFeedbackChange
props.note: null takes a rating back; a reason comes only with "down".

props.name: onCopy
props.note: The host copies the text it is given: the answer as written, a blank line, then «المصادر» (Sources) and one line per source, "{number}. {title}" in the reader's digits, with " — {link}" when the source's link is http or https, as URL normalises it (a direction override is percent-encoded). «نُسخت» shows for two seconds once the promise resolves. A host that ignores the text keeps working.

props.name: onRegenerate
props.note: In the bar when completed, and as the primary button when stopped.

props.name: onStop
props.note: Shown while thinking and writing.

props.name: onRetry
props.note: The primary button when the answer failed.

props.name: duration
props.note: Seconds the answer took, shown as ٦٫٢ث beside the sources' count.

props.name: error
props.note: What went wrong, as persistent text beside the partial answer of a failed status.

props.name: headingLevel
props.note: The question's level.

props.name: labels
props.note: Replaces any built-in text; thinkingPanel and feedbackBar carry the nested parts' words.

props.name: announcement
props.note: Speak status changes and successful copy feedback through one shared region. Set off when the host owns announcements; visible copy feedback is preserved and muted status changes are not replayed.

props.name: appearance
props.note: card sits on a tray with the answer on paper; plain lives on its host's paper.

components.state: The host owns the status, the text, the sources, the rating and every time. The pattern never advances by itself: it shows the thinking panel, streams the words it is given and reports what the person asks for. The panel folds when writing starts unless the host controls it.
accessibility: A section labelled by its question. One polite region says each status change once and announces successful copy feedback. The status on mount, answer text, chart and elapsed time are not announced. The thinking panel, streamed text and FeedbackBar suppress their own regions; the bar delegates copy confirmation to this pattern. announcement="off" removes the shared region so a host can own announcements, while preserving visible copy feedback.

A citation chip is a link when its source has a safe destination, so Enter and a click open it; otherwise it is a button that Tab reaches, and a click or focus previews it. Hover or focus shows the source's title and description in a tooltip that carries no link, Escape or blur closes it, and the pointer moving onto it keeps it open (WCAG 1.4.13). The chip's name is «المصدر ١: العنوان» in the provider's digits. A tap on a touch screen opens the source's card instead of following the link: a dialog named by the source's title, holding «فتح المصدر», which a second tap, a tap outside or Escape closes.

A failure stays as text beside the partial answer, with Try again. When a change removes the focused control (Stop, Try again, Regenerate), focus moves to the section. Moving to a status never moves focus.
limitations: No model call, retrieval, streaming transport or timer. Supply the sources, the numbers in the text and the times; update the time at most once a second.
The answer is Markdown with [n] markers, and a group such as [1, 3] is one marker; a number with no source leaves its whole marker as written, so supply every source the text cites.
Links in the answer are limited to http, https, relative and fragment destinations.
components.alternative: Use a ChatThread message for casual chat without sources, Agent task for multi-step work, and Sources with InlineCitation alone to cite inside your own content.

components.purpose: Turn a question about the person's data into a chart from the existing chart families, a two-sentence explanation that cites its tables by number, and a folded «كيف حُسب هذا؟» (date range, filters and source tables). The person can pin the chart, open it in a table and change its type; the states are thinking, completed, failed and empty.

props.name: status
props.note: Host-owned. Thinking opens the thinking panel on the tables found so far; completed shows the chart, the explanation, «كيف حُسب هذا؟» and the person's options; failed shows «تعذّر إكمال الإجابة» with `error` and Try again; empty shows «لا توجد بيانات لهذه الفترة» with «كيف حُسب هذا؟». The pill reads «يفكّر», «اكتملت» (completed and empty) or «تعثّرت».

props.name: question
props.note: The question, as the section's heading, beside the AI mark (turning while thinking) and the status pill.

props.name: chart
props.note: The chart family and its own props: { type: "line" | "area" | "bar", props: CartesianChartProps } or { type: "donut", props: DonutChartProps }. Drawn as given, once completed. The pattern never reshapes data: the host passes the data that fits the type it shows.

props.name: explanation
props.note: Markdown, two sentences, under the chart. A [n] marker names a source's number in `sources` and becomes a preview citation chip, written in ASCII, Arabic-Indic or Persian digits; a marker with no source stays text. Links in it pass through sourceHref.

props.name: sources
props.note: The tables the answer rests on, cited by number and listed in the method as «الجداول». Their titles are also the numbered lines of a copied answer.

props.name: method
props.note: How the answer was worked out: «الفترة» is `range`, «التصفية» is `filters` or «بلا تصفية», and «الجداول» lists `sources` as chips. Folded by default behind «كيف حُسب هذا؟», and shown when completed or empty. Without `method` there is no disclosure.

props.name: thinking
props.type: { elapsed: number; searched: readonly SourceReference[]; steps?: readonly { id: string; label: string; state: "pending" | "running" | "completed" }[] }
props.note: What the search covered, for the thinking panel: seconds, the tables found so far and the steps. The panel is open while thinking and folds after. When the answer failed it reads «تعثّر بعد ٦ث» with its thread still, so pass only what had arrived and mark no unfinished step completed. Update `elapsed` at most once a second. Without it there is no panel.

props.name: chartTypes
props.note: The types the person can switch between. With two or more, an `onChartTypeChange` and a completed answer, a native radio group «نوع الرسم» offers «خطوط», «مساحة», «أعمدة» and «حلقي». List the type `chart` shows. Offer only the families that fit the data.

props.name: onChartTypeChange
props.note: Called with the type the person chose. The pattern changes nothing itself: the radio and the chart stay as they are until the host passes a new `chart`.

props.name: onPin
props.note: «ثبّت في اللوحة», the primary button of a completed answer. It shows only with the handler; the host pins the chart.

props.name: onOpenTable
props.note: «افتح في جدول» on a completed answer. It shows only with the handler; the host opens the rows behind the chart.

props.name: onCopy
props.note: The host copies the text it is given: the explanation as written, a blank line, «كيف حُسب هذا؟» with «الفترة: …» and «التصفية: …», a blank line, then «المصادر» and one line per table, "{number}. {title}" in the reader's digits, with " — {link}" when its link is http or https. «نُسخت» shows for two seconds once the promise resolves. The copy button shows only with the handler, on a completed answer.

props.name: onRetry
props.note: The primary button when the answer failed.

props.name: error
props.note: What went wrong, as persistent text beside «تعذّر إكمال الإجابة» when the answer failed.

props.name: headingLevel
props.note: The question's level.

props.name: labels
props.note: Replaces any built-in text; thinkingPanel and feedbackBar carry the nested parts' words.

props.name: announcement
props.note: Speak status changes and successful copy feedback through one shared region. Set off when the host owns announcements; visible copy feedback is preserved and muted status changes are not replayed.

props.name: appearance
props.note: card sits on a tray with the chart and the explanation on paper; plain lives on its host's paper.

components.state: The host owns the status, the chart and its data for every type, the text, the tables and every time. The pattern never fetches, computes or reshapes anything and never advances by itself: it shows the thinking, draws the chart it is given, and reports what the person asks for, including the chart type to show next.
accessibility: A section labelled by its question. One polite region says each status change once and announces successful copy feedback. The status on mount, answer text, chart and elapsed time are not announced. The thinking panel, streamed text and FeedbackBar suppress their own regions; the bar delegates copy confirmation to this pattern. announcement="off" removes the shared region so a host can own announcements, while preserving visible copy feedback.

The status pill names the state once, in words: يفكّر, اكتملت or تعثّرت. The chart is a named region with its visible summary. «كيف حُسب هذا؟» is a button with aria-expanded over a definition list, which is hidden and inert while folded. The chart type is a native radio group named «نوع الرسم», so the arrow keys move and change it; each option is named by its visible word.
A failure stays as text with Try again. When a change removes the focused control (Try again, Pin, a chart type), focus moves to the section. Moving to a status never moves focus.
limitations: No data fetching, computing or charting logic: the host supplies the chart's data, every figure in the text and the times, and reshapes its data when the chart type changes. Update the thinking time at most once a second.

The explanation is Markdown with [n] markers, and a group such as [1, 3] is one marker; a number with no source leaves its whole marker as written, so supply every table the text cites. Digits in the text and the method are the host's: format them with numberLocale(config).
Use the families that fit the data: line and area for a trend over time, bar for a comparison, donut for the parts of a whole (it draws positive values only).
components.alternative: Use Cited answer for an answer from documents, a chart family alone for a figure that needs no explanation, DataTable for many records, and What changed for what moved this week.

components.purpose: Let an agent run a multi-step job while the person stays in control: a proposed plan, the run with steering and Stop, an inline approval when a step needs the person, a failed step's ways forward, and what the task produced.

props.name: title
props.note: The task in plain words; it names the section.

props.name: agent
props.note: Shown before the step count: وكيل المالية · ٥ خطوات. A needs-you step's approval names it as who asks, unless the step was handed to another agent.

props.name: status
props.note: Host-owned. The pill reads خطة مقترحة, يعمل, بانتظارك, تعثّرت, أُوقفت or اكتملت; the footer changes with it.

props.name: steps
props.note: Each step's state is host-owned: planned, pending, running, completed, needs-you, failed or skipped.

props.name: elapsed
props.note: Seconds, shown in the pill while running and once completed, and in the failed and stopped footers. Update it at most once a second; it is never announced.

props.name: outputs
props.type: readonly { id: string; label: ReactNode; icon?: ReactNode; onOpen?(): void }[]
props.note: What a completed task produced, as chips; a chip is a button only with onOpen.

props.name: autoStartAfter
props.note: Seconds before a proposed plan starts on its own, calling onStart. It pauses while the pointer or focus is inside and restarts when the plan changes.

props.name: onStart
props.note: Start now, Ctrl or Cmd+Enter (waits 500 ms after the plan appears and whenever a step is added, removed, reordered or retitled; a change to a step's `detail` alone does not restart it, so retitle a step whose substance changes; never on key repeat), or the countdown.

props.name: onSteer
props.note: The running footer's field: Enter steers at the next step, Ctrl or Cmd+Enter now; the field then clears and the region says سيُطبَّق مع الخطوة التالية: {text} or يُطبَّق الآن: {text}. Empty text and input-method composition never steer.

props.name: onApplyNoteNow
props.note: While running, a note not yet applied offers طبّق الآن, named طبّق الآن: {text}, for that note only. Mark it applied on the running step.

props.name: onRemoveNote
props.note: While running, a note not yet applied offers إزالة, named إزالة التوجيه: {text}, for that note only. Drop the note; focus then moves to the section.

props.name: onDecision
props.note: ApprovalCard's contract for a needs-you step's request, shown plain with its approval details. Without it the request shows as text, with no actions.

props.name: onReconnect
props.note: With onRetryStep and onSkipStep, the ways forward a failed step's error.actions lists.

props.name: primaryAction
props.note: The host's next action once the task completes.

props.name: headingLevel
props.note: The title's level; the inline approval and the tool details sit one deeper.

props.name: labels
props.note: Replaces any built-in text, including the step and operation counts.

props.name: announcement
props.note: Speak status and steering feedback politely by default. Set off when the host owns announcements; this also silences embedded approvals, even when their details request polite announcements. Muted status and note changes are not replayed when announcements resume.

props.name: appearance
props.note: card sits on a tray with the steps on paper; plain lives on its host's paper.

components.state: The host owns the status, the steps, the times and the outputs; the pattern never advances by itself. The countdown is a UI affordance the host opts into, and it calls onStart. The inline approval keeps ApprovalCard's decision integrity: a decision counts only after the host's promise resolves.
accessibility: A section labelled by its title. One polite region says each status once in one sentence: خطة مقترحة (with the countdown's sentence), يعمل, {title}: يحتاج قرارك, تعثّرت: {error title}, أُوقفت and اكتملت المهمة. It also says each note once: where a sent note goes, and أخذ الوكيل بتوجيهك: {text} when a note's applied turns true; notes applied at mount are not news. Elapsed time, step durations and countdown ticks never reach it; the countdown and the tool calls run with announcement off, and the inline approval keeps its own region. Set announcement="off" to silence both the task region and embedded approval regions when the host owns announcements.

Each step's icon has a hidden state word (لم تبدأ، قيد التنفيذ، بانتظارك، مكتملة، تعثّرت، تُخطّيت); a failure stays as text beside its step. Details are a disclosure whose closed panel is hidden and inert at once; collapsing returns focus to Details unless the person moved it elsewhere. When a change removes the focused control, focus moves to the section. Moving to needs-you never moves focus.
limitations: No agent runtime, scheduling, retries or timers of its own beyond the opt-in countdown. Supply stable unique step IDs.
Approval records a decision only; the host validates and executes it, and shows the outcome on the step.
components.alternative: Use ApprovalCard for a single yes or no, TaskRows for a list of tasks without a run, or a table for many tasks at a glance.

components.purpose: Collect what waits on the person from every agent in one place, most urgent first: tabs with counts (الكل، بانتظارك، يعمل، اكتملت), rows that open into the full Approval request or Clarifying questions, quick decisions for reversible requests only, receipts, and an optional agents strip. There is no approve-all.

props.name: items
props.note: In the host's order, most urgent first; the inbox keeps it. Each item is an approval (request with approval), questions, a draft (draft: true) or a task, with a status of needs-you, running, failed or completed. «بانتظارك» holds needs-you and failed items, «يعمل» running ones, «اكتملت» completed ones and «الكل» every item.

props.name: tab
props.note: The shown tab; controlled with onTabChange. Each tab shows its count in the reader's digits. Changing the tab announces nothing.

props.name: expanded
props.note: The open rows' ids; controlled with onExpandedChange. A row opens from its title, a disclosure button with aria-expanded, or from «راجع» / «أجب»; focus stays on the trigger and nothing in the row takes it. A row whose quick decision is in flight stays closed even when expanded names it, and an open row whose card is recording a decision stays open: its title and Escape leave it be until the host answers. A row with no steps, request or questions has nothing to open, and its title is a heading that takes focus only when a moving row hands it on.

props.name: agents
props.type: readonly { id: string; name: ReactNode; state: StatusPillState }[]
props.note: The agents strip, a group named «الوكلاء» of aria-pressed toggles, each naming its agent and its StatusPill word.

props.name: agent
props.note: The picked agent, which filters the rows and the counts. Uncontrolled, none is picked.

props.name: onAgentChange
props.note: A press calls it with the agent's id, and a press on the picked one with null.

props.name: onDecision
props.type: (request: ApprovalRequest, decision: ApprovalDecision, context: { signal: AbortSignal }) => void | Promise<void>
props.note: Records the decision of an open row's ApprovalCard (plain, a heading deeper, with Mod+Enter only for reversible and not irreversible, and its 500 ms guard), or a quick one. Quick decisions show only for a needs-you request whose approval is reversible, neither irreversible nor expired, while its row is closed: secondary Reject and Approve, with no shortcut, named with the row's title. One runs at a time and counts only once the promise resolves; a change to the request, its expiry or its reversibility aborts it, so a late resolve records nothing, and remounts the quick buttons, so focus on one moves to the row's title. Without onDecision a request shows its action and target as text, with no actions.

props.name: onAnswer
props.type: (id: string, answers: QuestionAnswers, context: { signal: AbortSignal }) => void | Promise<void>
props.note: Submits a question row's answers from its plain AskUserQuestions. The inbox keeps each row's draft answers. Without it the questions show as text.

props.name: onRetry
props.note: «أعد المحاولة» on a failed row, beside its error.

props.name: onOpen
props.note: «افتح» on running and completed rows, and «راجع» on a draft: the host opens it in its own view, never inside the row.

props.name: receiptFor
props.note: Seconds a row the host moved out of the shown tab stays in place with its receipt (item.receipt, else the quick decision's receipt, else the new status's pill word) before it leaves without a glide. A UI timer: 0 moves a resolved row at once.

props.name: title
props.note: The section's heading; «صندوق القرارات» / Decision inbox by default.

props.name: headingLevel
props.note: The title's level; rows sit one deeper and an open row's card or questions one deeper again.

props.name: labels
props.note: Replaces any built-in text; waiting(count, requests) and running(count, tasks) build the region's sentence from the count helper's words.

props.name: appearance
props.note: card sits on a tray with the tabs and rows on paper; plain lives on its host's paper, as in a Sheet.

components.state: The host owns every item, its status, its request and its times; the inbox never resolves, moves or removes an item by itself. It holds only UI state: the uncontrolled tab, open rows and agent, each question row's draft answers, a quick decision in flight, and the receipt timer for a row the host moved out of the shown tab.
accessibility: A section labelled by its title. One polite region, empty at mount, speaks only when the counts change, joining its non-zero parts with « · »: «طلبان بانتظارك · ٣ مهام تعمل», or «لا شيء بانتظارك». Changing the tab or picking an agent says nothing; the open card keeps its own region.

Opening a row never moves focus, and nothing inside takes it; a new or changed item never moves focus. Escape anywhere in an open row, the card included, folds it, returns focus to its title and records nothing: the row takes the key in its capture phase, and the card's DecisionBar drops its Esc hint there. While a decision in the open row is being recorded, Escape and the title leave the row open. When a row's own action goes away, such as an accepted quick decision or Try again, focus moves to that row's title, which the receipt then describes (aria-describedby). When a row leaves, or the host deletes it, while focus is in it, focus goes to the next row's title, else the previous row's, else the tab panel.

Each row action is named by its own word and then the row's title through aria-labelledby, so «رفض» reads «رفض ترحيل قيود الاستحقاق الأربعة». Each row's pill names its status in words (بانتظارك، بانتظار مراجعتك، يعمل، تعثّرت، اكتملت), a failed row's error stays as text, and each step's icon has a hidden state word.
limitations: No approve-all, ever: every decision is about one request. Mark reversible, irreversible and expired honestly, because they decide whether a row decides without opening. A receipt says what was recorded, never what the agent then did.
The receipt timer is the only clock; the host formats every time. Drafts are reviewed where the host opens them (onOpen), not inside the inbox.
components.alternative: Use ApprovalCard for a single request, ApprovalFlow for a short run of requests decided one at a time, and Agent task for one agent's run.

components.purpose: Improve selected text with tracked changes the person accepts or rejects: the selection actions on the host's text, a note while the assistant rewrites, a review card with each change, a counter, Reject all and Accept all, and a receipt once the host applies the result.

props.name: children
props.note: The text region, as SelectionActions wraps it: read-only rendered text such as a message or a report paragraph.

props.name: actions
props.type: readonly { id: string; label: string; icon?: ReactNode }[]
props.note: The rewrites offered on a selection, for example أقصر، أوضح، أكثر رسمية، ترجم إلى الإنجليزية. They show while idle and once applied.

props.name: onAction
props.type: (id: string, selection: { text: string; start: number; end: number }) => void
props.note: The person chose an action on a selection: its text, and its start and end offsets in the region's text content. The host sets rewriting and asks its model.

props.name: status
props.note: Host-owned. rewriting marks the range and shows «يعيد الصياغة…» with the stitch line below it; reviewing opens the review card below the range; applied shows the receipt under the text.

props.name: suggestion
props.note: The card's title after «اقتراح المساعد ·», for example اجعلها أقصر, and the selected passage as diff segments. Keep it through applied: the receipt counts its changes.

props.name: selection
props.note: The range the suggestion is for, as onAction reported it, for a host that restores a saved suggestion. Without it, the last action's range.

props.name: reviewPlacement
props.note: Floating uses a viewport-contained popover that may flip above the selection. Inline keeps the same non-modal review after the text in document flow, filling its host; use it when space should be occupied below a clause on narrow screens. Moving between placements restores focus to the review heading if a focused review control was removed.

props.name: decisions
props.note: Keyed by each change's first segment id. Without it the pattern keeps its own, afresh with each action.

props.name: onDecisionsChange
props.note: Each accept and reject, and Accept all and Reject all.

props.name: onApply
props.type: (text: string, selection: { start: number; end: number }) => void
props.note: The passage with the accepted changes applied (rejected and undecided ones keep the original), and the range it replaces. The host replaces its own text; until then its DOM is untouched. Apply shows only once the range is known.

props.name: onUndo
props.note: Undo in the receipt, only when given.

props.name: onDismiss
props.note: Dismiss in the card, and Escape while rewriting, reviewing or applied. Focus returns to the text region.

props.name: labels
props.note: Replaces any built-in text, InlineDiff's words included.

props.name: announcement
props.note: Speaks status changes politely by default; off removes the live region while keeping the visible rewriting note and receipt.

components.state: The host owns the status, the suggestion, the decisions (or leaves them to the pattern) and its own text, which it replaces on Apply. The pattern keeps only the last action's range and which change the counter is on. It never rewrites anything itself.
accessibility: One polite region says each change of status in one sentence: يعيد الصياغة…, اقتراح المساعد جاهز للمراجعة: ٣ تعديلات, then the receipt, such as طُبّق تعديلان من ٣. The status the pattern mounts in is not announced. Pass announcement="off" when the host screen owns announcements; the visible note and receipt remain.

The review card is a non-modal dialog labelled by its heading. When it opens after the pattern mounted, focus moves to its heading if it was in the selection toolbar or on the page; focus the person put elsewhere stays. Escape calls onDismiss and returns focus to the text region, and a control that takes itself away (Apply, Undo) hands focus to the text region too.

Each change is a focusable group named by what it does, with its own accept and reject toggle buttons. Y accepts and N rejects while focus is in a change, matched by key position so an Arabic layout works, and never on a repeat, with Ctrl, Meta or Alt, or in a text field. The counter keeps its width as it counts.

A deletion is struck through and an insertion underlined, so neither rests on color alone. The range's underline uses the CSS Custom Highlight API (::highlight(tz-suggestion)); where the API is missing the range is not marked.
limitations: No rewriting, model call or text replacement: the host supplies the suggestion and replaces its own text on Apply.

The diff works on the plain text of the selection, so a range across formatting is applied as plain text and the card says «يُطبَّق كنص عادي». Selections follow SelectionActions: read-only text inside one scope. Editable drafts use InlineDiff directly.
Offsets count the region's text content, so they hold only while the host's text does; a host that changes its text before Apply should dismiss the suggestion.
components.alternative: Use SelectionActions alone to copy or quote a selection, Agent task when the assistant writes new messages for records, and the new version beside the old one when nearly every word changes.

components.purpose: Make an image from a description and pick the version to use: the prompt and what was asked with it, a soft whole-image preview that gains clarity as it is made, a size tag and a progress tag on the canvas, the versions as a named radio group, and the person's actions once it is done. The weave stays under the finished image, so while the picture loads neither completing nor choosing another version blinks. A failed image shows its text with Try again; a refused request shows its reason with Edit with a description.

props.name: prompt
props.note: The person's description of the image, in the prompt row. It sets its own direction (dir=auto).

props.name: options
props.note: What was asked besides the description, such as the ratio, the style and the count, as read-only chips.

props.name: status
props.note: Host-owned. queued and weaving show the WeaveCanvas, with the versions and actions inert; completed shows the chosen image as an ImageResult with them live; failed shows the failure with Try again; blocked shows blockedReason with Edit with a description. The pill reads في الانتظار, يُنسج, جاهزة, تعثّرت or بانتظارك.

props.name: progress
props.note: Actual host progress from 0 to 100. The reveal follows it, and the tag reads يُنسج · ٤٢٪ in a fixed width. Omit it or pass null while it is unknown: the tag reads يُنسج with no aria-valuenow.

props.name: images
props.type: readonly { id: string; src?: string; alt: string; width: number; height: number }[]
props.note: The versions, in order. width and height give the canvas its shape before the picture exists; alt names the chosen image for assistive technology, in the weave and in the failure; src may be missing until the picture exists. The thumbnails are drawn only once the images are done.

props.name: selected
props.note: The chosen image's id. Without it the pattern keeps its own choice, from the first image.

props.name: onSelectedChange
props.note: Called with the id of the version the person chose in the radio group.

props.name: onUse
props.note: Use image, with the chosen id. It shows from the start and works once the images are done.

props.name: onVariations
props.note: Similar variations, with the chosen id. It shows from the start and works once the images are done.

props.name: onEditPrompt
props.note: Edit with a description, in the prompt row and in the blocked view.

props.name: onRetry
props.note: Try again in the failed view. Focus moves to the figure first; if the figure then goes, it moves to the section.

props.name: blockedReason
props.note: Why the request was refused. The blocked view shows it as persistent text and the live region reads it.

props.name: agent
props.note: The agent that made the images, first in the footer.

props.name: duration
props.note: Seconds the generation took, last in the footer as ١٢ث or 12s. Pass it once, when it is done.

props.name: headingLevel
props.note: The title's level.

props.name: labels
props.note: Replaces any built-in text.

props.name: appearance
props.note: card sits on a tray with the canvas on paper; plain lives on its host's paper.

props.name: announcement
props.note: Speaks status changes politely by default; off also makes the failed ImageResult status plain while keeping its visible error and alt text.

components.state: The host owns the status, the progress, the images and, if it wants, the chosen version. The pattern never generates an image, simulates progress or advances its status; it reports the version chosen, Use image, Similar variations, Edit with a description and Try again.
accessibility: A section labelled by its title. One polite region says each change of status in one sentence: الصورة في الانتظار, تُنسج الصورة, الصورة جاهزة, تعذّر توليد الصورة, or لا يمكن توليد هذه الصورة with its reason. The status the pattern mounts in is not announced, and neither are the progress or the time. Pass announcement="off" when the host screen owns announcements; its failed ImageResult is plain text too.

While it is made the canvas is one image named by the chosen image's alt; the picture and the atmospheric light are decoration and hidden. Once the images are done the weave stays under the result as hidden decoration. The progress tag is the pattern's progressbar: aria-valuenow only when progress is known, and a text value such as يُنسج · ٤٢٪ in a fixed width.

The versions are a native radio group named اختر نسخة, each thumbnail named النسخة ١ and so on. They and the actions are disabled and dimmed until the images are done. The chosen version has a ring and a check, so color is not its only signal.
When Try again takes the focused figure away, focus moves to the section instead of the page; so does focus on an action that goes quiet.

The preview smooths real progress changes with one short animation-frame loop; the atmospheric light moves through CSS only while weaving. Under reduced motion, from the application or the OS, nothing loops: a still thread shows while waiting for a picture, and the picture fades in whole over 200 ms. Keyboard modality does not stop it.
limitations: No image generation and no progress: the host supplies the status, the progress and every image. The soft-focus reveal uses the host's own picture, so it shows a picture only once a src exists. Unknown progress keeps the preview soft until completed and never advances a percentage.
Image URLs are the host's: the pattern loads them as given and fetches nothing else.
components.alternative: Use ImageResult to show an image the host already has, and Agent task when the image is one step of larger work.

components.purpose: The assistant writes a message for a record; the person reviews, edits and sends it. The record (invoice number, customer, amount in figure type, overdue tag) frames the draft on the tray. The paper holds the recipient and attachment chips, the message with an optional suggested edit as tracked changes, and the tone (ودّي، مختصر، رسمي). Discard and Send, with Ctrl or Cmd+Enter, decide it. Sending leaves a receipt, with Undo only while the host holds the message.

props.name: status
props.note: Host-owned; the pattern never advances it. The pill reads يكتب (running), بانتظار مراجعتك (needs-you), تُرسَل (running), أُرسلت (completed) or تم التجاهل (stopped). Discard and Send show only while ready; the hold while sending; the receipt once sent or discarded.

props.name: title
props.note: The section's heading; «مسودة للمراجعة» / Draft for review by default.

props.name: record
props.type: { id: string; customer: ReactNode; amount: ReactNode; overdue?: ReactNode }
props.note: The record the draft is about, on the tray under the header: the id in <bdi dir="ltr">, the customer, the amount at --text-figure-small with tabular figures, and overdue in an error Badge. Format the amount and the days with numberLocale.

props.name: recipients
props.note: The «إلى» chips, each label in its own direction. Their ids are part of what Ctrl or Cmd+Enter waits on, so a new recipient makes it wait 500 ms again.

props.name: attachments
props.note: The «المرفقات» chips, such as a file name, each in its own direction. Their ids are part of what Ctrl or Cmd+Enter waits on.

props.name: body
props.note: The message. While writing it is the host's growing text, read-only under a running Thread; ready without a suggestion, a «نص الرسالة» Textarea when onBodyChange is given, else text. Send hands it over when no suggestion shows.

props.name: onBodyChange
props.note: Makes the body a text area while ready without a suggestion.

props.name: suggestion
props.type: { title?: ReactNode; segments: readonly DiffSegment[]; decisions: Readonly<Record<string, "accepted" | "rejected">>; onDecisionsChange: (next: Record<string, "accepted" | "rejected">) => void }
props.note: A suggested edit, shown while ready as «اقتراح المساعد · title» over InlineDiff, with decisions keyed by each change's first segment id. While it shows, Send hands over the text as decided: each accepted change's new text, and the original text for the rest.

props.name: tone
props.note: The checked tone.

props.name: onToneChange
props.note: The «النبرة» group of native radios (ودّي، مختصر، رسمي) shows only with it, and a choice only calls it. The radios are disabled from sending on. A new tone makes Ctrl or Cmd+Enter wait 500 ms again.

props.name: onSend
props.note: Send («إرسال», the primary button, with Mod+Enter) while ready. Called once per ready status with the text on screen; further clicks, chords and held keys do nothing until the status changes. The chord waits 500 ms after mount and after the text, the tone, the recipients or the attachments change. Move to sending in the same update, because Send and Discard stay locked until the status changes; if sending fails, return to ready, and the region says «تعذّر إرسال الرسالة، والمسودة محفوظة», which also shows as an error above Send.

props.name: onDiscard
props.note: Discard («تجاهل») while ready. It never sends, and once Send or Discard has acted neither acts again until the status changes.

props.name: undoWindow
props.note: The whole seconds left in the host's hold when the countdown mounts, not the hold's full length, so a remount never offers Undo after the hold ends. Above zero and with onUndo, sending shows «تُرسَل خلال {t}» with a Countdown that never pauses (announcement off) and «تراجع»; when it ends, Undo goes and the line reads «تُرسَل الآن…». Undo shows only while the host holds the message, and the host takes the window from a setting the person controls before meeting it: off, or adjustable to at least ten times the default (WCAG 2.2.1). A receipt records the sending, never a recall.

props.name: onUndo
props.note: Called once; Undo then shows loading. Cancel the hold and return to ready if it arrives in time; otherwise send and mark it sent, and the region says it was sent before it could be cancelled. A receipt records the sending, never a recall.

props.name: agent
props.note: The agent that wrote the draft, under the title.

props.name: headingLevel
props.note: The title's level.

props.name: labels
props.note: Replaces any built-in text; inlineDiff carries the tracked changes' words.

props.name: appearance
props.note: card sits on a tray with the message on paper; plain lives on its host's paper, as in a conversation or a side panel.

props.name: announcement
props.note: Speaks status changes politely by default; off removes the live region while keeping the visible receipt, sending line and error text.

components.state: The host owns the status, the text, the suggestion and its decisions, the tone, the recipients, the attachments and the sending: it holds the message for its undo window, sends it once the window ends, cancels it on onUndo, and marks it sent. The pattern sends and cancels nothing itself. It holds only UI state: whether Send, Discard or Undo has acted in this status, and whether its countdown has ended.
accessibility: A section labelled by its title. One polite region, empty at mount, says each change of status once: يكتب المسودة; المسودة بانتظار مراجعتك; تُرسَل الرسالة, or with an undo window تُرسَل الرسالة خلال ١٠ث. يمكنك التراجع.; أُلغي الإرسال، والمسودة محفوظة when an Undo takes sending back to ready, and otherwise تعذّر إرسال الرسالة، والمسودة محفوظة, also shown as an error Alert above Send; أُرسلت الرسالة, or after an Undo أُرسلت الرسالة قبل أن يُلغى الإرسال; تم تجاهل المسودة. The countdown never speaks, and neither its ticks nor a new undoWindow reach the region. Pass announcement="off" when the host screen owns announcements; visible receipts and errors remain.
Send, Discard and Undo go away with their status, and focus then moves to the section, as it does from a text area, a tracked change or a tone that a change removes or disables.

The record's id is isolated left to right, each chip in its own direction, and the overdue tag is an error Badge with words. The tone is a native radio group named «النبرة». Each button is named by its visible word, and Send's shortcut is its description.
limitations: No sending, no recall and no clock but the countdown, which shows the host's window and never pauses. A receipt records the sending, never a recall. Undo shows only while the host holds the message (undoWindow with onUndo); the host takes the window from a setting the person controls before meeting it, either off or adjustable to at least ten times the default (WCAG 2.2.1), and undoWindow is the seconds left in that hold, not its full length.
The suggestion is plain text, and its segments cover the whole message. A draft waiting in the Decision inbox opens here through the inbox's onOpen.
components.alternative: Use Suggested edits to rewrite the person's own text, and Approval request for a one-time decision about an action rather than a message to review.

components.purpose: Tell a manager what moved, why it moved, and what to do next: up to six rows with a trend badge and a sparkline, the most likely reason with citations, the next steps, and what the summary rests on.

props.name: title
props.note: The heading; «ما الذي تغيّر» by default.

props.name: status
props.note: Host-owned. Updating turns the rows into skeleton lines with a soft shimmer and the pill reads يحدّث; ready and stale carry «أعدّه المساعد», and stale adds «قد يكون الملخص قديمًا» with Refresh; failed shows the pill تعثّر and Try again.

props.name: rows
props.type: readonly { id: string; metric: string; change: ReactNode; direction: "up" | "down" | "flat"; tone: "good" | "bad" | "neutral"; series?: readonly number[] }[]
props.note: The first six show. change is the change in words with no + or − sign. direction draws the arrow and its hidden word (ارتفع, انخفض, ثابت); tone is the meaning, in the color: good is success, bad is danger, neutral is muted. series draws a sparkline that runs left to right in both directions.

props.name: reason
props.note: The most likely reason, under «السبب الأرجح».

props.name: sources
props.note: A citation chip after the reason for each source.

props.name: basedOn
props.note: The footer's first line, for example «اعتمادًا على ٣ تقارير».

props.name: updated
props.note: The footer's second line, for example «حُدّث قبل ٥ د».

props.name: actions
props.type: readonly { id: string; label: string; primary?: boolean; onSelect(): void }[]
props.note: One primary next step and one secondary, in the footer. They show only while the summary is ready, so no step rests on numbers that may be old.

props.name: onRefresh
props.note: Refresh while stale and Try again when failed.

props.name: headingLevel
props.note: The title's level.

props.name: labels
props.note: Replaces any built-in text.

props.name: appearance
props.note: card sits on a tray with the rows on paper; plain lives on its host's paper.

props.name: announcement
props.note: Speaks status changes politely by default; off removes the live region while keeping visible status and footer text.

components.state: The host owns the status, the rows, their tones, the reason and the times. The pattern never refreshes by itself; Refresh and Try again call onRefresh and the host sets updating.
accessibility: A section labelled by its title. One polite region says each change of status in one sentence: يحدّث الملخص, الملخص جاهز, قد يكون الملخص قديمًا or تعذّر تحديث الملخص. The status the summary mounts in is not announced, and an unchanged status is not announced again. Pass announcement="off" when the host screen owns announcements; visible status and footer text remain.

Each row reads as its metric, a direction word and the change: the arrow is decorative, the word is hidden text and the color is never the only signal for the direction. The sparkline is decoration and hidden from assistive technology. While updating, the skeleton rows are hidden and the paper is aria-busy.
When a change removes the focused control (Refresh), focus moves to the section.
limitations: No data fetching, comparison or generation: the host supplies every row, tone and sentence. The tone is the host's judgement of good or bad, and it is conveyed by color and by the host's own wording.
Only the first six rows show. Digits in the rows are the host's text, so format them with numberLocale(config).
components.alternative: Use a chart for one measure over time, a DataTable for many records, and InsightCards for findings read one at a time.

components.purpose: Decide what the assistant may do without asking, what it remembers and how much context it uses: a level for each action, locked to «اسأل دائمًا» for an action that can't be undone; a memory switch with the remembered items under their categories, each paused or deleted by name; and the context meter's detail view with an optional model selector. These are the person's settings, so the pattern has no AI mark, no status pill and no states of its own.

props.name: permissions
props.note: One fieldset per action, shown when given: the legend names the action with its risk tags (حساس, a neutral Badge; لا يمكن التراجع, a warning Badge), its description describes it, and three native radios read اسأل دائمًا، إن كان حساسًا، تلقائي بالكامل with the host's level checked. An action whose risks include irreversible is locked: اسأل دائمًا is checked whatever level says, the other two are disabled, and a lock with «لا يمكن التراجع عن هذا الإجراء، لذلك يسألك المساعد قبله دائمًا.» describes the fieldset.

props.name: onPermissionChange
props.note: The person's choice for an action. Never called for a locked one. Store the level and enforce it when the assistant acts; the pattern only shows and reports it. Without it the radios are disabled.

props.name: memoryEnabled
props.note: The «استخدم الذاكرة» switch. While it is false, «لا يستخدم المساعد الذاكرة الآن.» sits over the list.

props.name: onMemoryEnabledChange
props.note: The switch's change; without it the switch is disabled.

props.name: memory
props.note: The remembered items, grouped under their category headings (two levels below the title) in the order the categories first appear. Each shows its text, «{source} · {date}» and, when paused, «متوقف مؤقتًا».

props.name: onMemoryPauseChange
props.note: «إيقاف مؤقت» or «استئناف» on each item, named with the item through aria-labelledby, called with the opposite of paused.

props.name: onMemoryDelete
props.note: «حذف» on each item, named with the item. It only asks: the item stays until the host removes it from memory (after a confirmation where it can't be restored), and the pattern never says it was deleted. When it goes, focus moves to the section.

props.name: contextUsage
props.note: The «السياق والاستخدام» section's ContextMeter, shown inline: each part's share and a bar, its action once the meter fills up, and its polite region, which is the pattern's one live region.

props.name: models
props.note: For hosts that expose models: a ModelSelector named «النموذج», as the visible label beside it.

props.name: model
props.note: The selected model's id.

props.name: onModelChange
props.note: The selector's change; without it the selector is disabled.

props.name: title
props.note: The section's heading; «إعدادات المساعد» / Assistant controls by default.

props.name: headingLevel
props.note: The title's level; the three sections sit one lower and the memory categories two.

props.name: labels
props.note: Replaces any built-in text.

props.name: appearance
props.note: card sits on a tray with the sections on paper; plain lives on its host's paper, as in a side panel or a settings page.

components.state: The host owns every setting: each action's level, whether memory is on, the remembered items and whether each is paused, the context usage and the model. It stores and enforces them. The pattern shows them and reports the person's choices, and keeps only where focus was. A locked action shows «اسأل دائمًا» whatever level the host passes, and an item the person asks to delete stays until the host removes it.
accessibility: A section labelled by its title, with no AI mark and no status pill. Its three sections, «الصلاحيات», «الذاكرة» and «السياق والاستخدام», are headed one level down and show only when their data is given.

Each action is a fieldset named by its legend, the action and its risk tags, and described by its description and, when locked, the lock sentence. Its levels are native radios, so arrows move and choose; a locked action's other two radios are disabled.

Each memory item's buttons are named by their word and then the item: «حذف تفضّل شركة مدار التواصل مع سارة العتيبي». When a deleted item's buttons take focus with them it moves to the section, and when the meter's action does, once there is room, it moves to the meter's group.
The context meter's region is the pattern's one polite region: «السياق: يقترب من الامتلاء», once each time the status word changes, never at mount and never a number.
limitations: No storage, enforcement or deletion: the host saves each level and applies it when the assistant acts, deletes memories and summarizes the conversation. Only irreversible locks a level, and only to اسأل دائمًا; sensitive is a tag, and the host decides what إن كان حساسًا covers.
Item buttons show only with their handlers. A deletion is confirmed by the item leaving the host's list; the pattern announces no deletion of its own.
components.alternative: Use ContextMeter alone for a context ring in a toolbar, Start a task for the mode menu with models, and Switch or RadioGroup for settings that aren't about the assistant.

components.state: Host supplies command/output, execution state, exit code and display duration. Clipboard feedback is internal and ignores stale completions.
accessibility: LTR whitespace-preserving plain text within RTL. Focusable named internally scrolling region. Check-only copy success with polite announcement; visible accessible copy failure.
