props.note: Unique and stable.

props.name: title
props.note: The row's heading: its disclosure button when the row has steps, a request or questions.

props.name: agent
props.note: The agent it comes from; the strip filters by id, and the row names it in <bdi>.

props.name: context
props.note: One line after the agent, such as «ضمن إقفال حسابات أكتوبر»: «{agent} · {context} · {time}».

props.name: status
props.note: Host-owned. Failed items wait in «بانتظارك» with the needs-you ones.

props.name: time
props.note: Host-formatted, such as «قبل ٤ د».

props.name: request
props.note: An approval, shown in full as a plain ApprovalCard when its row opens, while the item needs you.

props.name: approval
props.note: Spread onto that card. reversible, without irreversible or expired, lets the closed row decide quickly.

props.name: questions
props.note: Questions answered in the open row through onAnswer.

props.name: draft
props.note: A draft waiting for review: the pill reads «بانتظار مراجعتك» and «راجع» calls onOpen(id).

props.name: steps
props.type: readonly { id: string; label: ReactNode; state: TaskState; time?: ReactNode }[]
props.note: The last three or four steps, oldest first, above the open row's request.

props.name: error
props.note: A failed item's error, as persistent text in its row.

props.name: receipt
props.note: What happened, shown while the row leaves its tab, such as «تمت الموافقة · الآن». Say only what was recorded.

props.name: byStatus
props.note: Names the tabs: «الطلبات حسب الحالة».

props.name: pills
props.note: Each row's pill; failed and completed agree with المهمة.

props.name: draft
props.note: A waiting draft's pill: «بانتظار مراجعتك».

props.name: waiting
props.note: «{requests} بانتظارك»; requests is formatCount(count, "request").

props.name: running
props.note: «{tasks} تعمل», «{tasks} تعملان» for two; tasks is formatCount(count, "task").

props.name: contextStatus
props.note: The region's sentence when the ring's status word changes: «السياق: {status}» / Context: {status}.

props.name: stopped
props.note: The header of a stopped search: «أُوقف بعد ٦ث». elapsed is empty when there is no time.

props.name: failed
props.note: The header of a failed search: «تعثّر بعد ٦ث». elapsed is empty when there is no time.

props.name: showAll
props.note: Hidden text after «+٢» in the sources button's name: «عرض كل المصادر».

props.name: showFewer
props.note: The sources button once every source shows: «عرض أقل».

props.name: label
props.note: The action, in the person's words: «إرسال رسائل للعملاء».

props.name: level
props.note: The stored level: اسأل دائمًا، إن كان حساسًا or تلقائي بالكامل. Ignored for an irreversible action, which always asks.

props.name: risks
props.note: Tags: sensitive (حساس, neutral) and irreversible (لا يمكن التراجع, warning), which locks the level to always.

props.name: text
props.note: What the assistant remembers: «تفضّل شركة مدار التواصل مع سارة العتيبي». It also names the item's buttons.

props.name: category
props.note: The heading it sits under; categories keep the order they first appear in.

props.name: date
props.note: Formatted by the host, with numberLocale for its digits.

props.name: paused
props.note: Shows «متوقف مؤقتًا» and turns Pause into Resume.

props.name: title
props.note: The heading when the host gives no title: «إعدادات المساعد».

props.name: context
props.note: «السياق والاستخدام».

props.name: levels
props.note: اسأل دائمًا، إن كان حساسًا، تلقائي بالكامل.

props.name: risks
props.note: حساس، لا يمكن التراجع.

props.name: locked
props.note: Describes a locked action: «لا يمكن التراجع عن هذا الإجراء، لذلك يسألك المساعد قبله دائمًا.».

props.name: memoryOff
props.note: «لا يستخدم المساعد الذاكرة الآن.»

props.name: id
props.note: Unique in the passage; a change is keyed by its first segment's id.

props.name: applied
props.type: (count: number, edits: string, total: string) => string

props.name: title
props.note: The heading when the host gives no title: «مسودة للمراجعة».

props.name: pills
props.note: The pill's word for each status, agreeing with الرسالة: يكتب، بانتظار مراجعتك، تُرسَل، أُرسلت، تم التجاهل.

props.name: suggestion
props.note: Heads a suggested edit, before its own title: «اقتراح المساعد».

props.name: message
props.note: Names the text area: «نص الرسالة».

props.name: tones
props.note: ودّي، مختصر، رسمي.

props.name: sendingIn
props.note: The line while the host holds the message: «تُرسَل خلال {time}», with time from the countdown.

props.name: sendingNow
props.note: The line once the hold is over, or without one: «تُرسَل الآن…».

props.name: sent
props.note: The sent receipt, which the region also says: «أُرسلت الرسالة».

props.name: discarded
props.note: The discarded receipt, which the region also says: «تم تجاهل المسودة».

props.name: saysSendingIn
props.note: «تُرسَل الرسالة خلال {time}. يمكنك التراجع.», said once when sending starts with an undo window.

props.name: saysCancelled
props.note: Said when an Undo takes sending back to ready: «أُلغي الإرسال، والمسودة محفوظة».

props.name: saysSentAfterUndo
props.note: Said when the message was sent after an Undo: «أُرسلت الرسالة قبل أن يُلغى الإرسال».

props.name: notSent
props.note: Said when sending goes back to ready without an Undo, and shown as an error Alert above Send until the person sends again: «تعذّر إرسال الرسالة، والمسودة محفوظة».

props.name: config
props.note: When supplied, full required config fields are needed; partial overrides are not merged. Use {...defaultConfig, ...overrides}.

support.purpose: Scope tokens, direction and portal container; accepts no other wrapper attributes. Set lang on a host ancestor above the provider/document so all scoped overlays and notices inherit it.

Typed shared settings, Arabic/compact defaults and paired light/dark accent values; configuration.fields is authoritative metadata. numberLocale(config, language?) returns the Intl locale for digits: ar-u-nu-arab or ar-u-nu-latn for Arabic (per config.numerals), any other language as supplied; language defaults from direction. Use it with useSystem().config for application-formatted numbers and dates.
Returns {config, container: HTMLDivElement | null}. Outside a provider returns defaultConfig/null; CSS styling is not installed automatically. SystemContext is internal, not a barrel export.
Provider props and lifecycle are documented by the toast family.
Returns {toast(message: ToastMessage): void}; use within ToastProvider or it throws. ToastContext is internal, not a barrel export; ToastMessage fields are in records.

Sidebar accepts native aside props/ref. SidebarHeader/Footer native div, SidebarContent native nav (supply aria-label), SidebarLabel native span. SidebarGroup native div plus optional heading:string. SidebarItem native anchor excluding children plus required label:string, icon:ReactNode, optional count:string|number, active:boolean=false; real href supplied by caller. SidebarAction native button excluding children plus label, icon, count. SidebarToggle native button plus required collapseLabel/expandLabel strings. SidebarDisclosure native button excluding children plus required label/icon/children, optional count, activeChild=false, open/defaultOpen=false/onOpenChange. All native attributes/events/ref/className/style remain on the underlying element. Buttons default type=button. Preventing default in click cancels built-in toggle/disclosure behavior. SidebarIdentity is a native div/ref for icon/avatar + SidebarLabel composition; header aligns identity/toggle in a row, then stacks them in the rail. Footer identity centers the actual avatar box in the rail.

props.name: state
props.note: pending, running, needs-you, completed, failed, stopped or skipped. Completed is the success color, failed the danger color and needs-you the attention color, each a filled disc; pending and skipped are dashed rings, and stopped is an outlined ring holding a small square.

props.name: number
props.note: Position of an ordered item. Only a pending icon shows it, formatted with numberLocale (Arabic-Indic digits by default); without it, or for a negative or non-finite value, the dashed ring stays empty and takes the field boundary color, so the ring alone keeps 3:1.

props.name: tone
props.note: Pass ai when the assistant is the actor: it turns the running arc to the AI color instead of the neutral text color. No other state changes with tone.

props.name: label
props.note: Accessible name. Without one the icon is decorative and aria-hidden, which is right wherever adjacent text already states the status; with one it is an img.

support.purpose: The shared status glyph of ToolCall, ToolChips and TaskRows: one vocabulary of seven states for tasks, tool calls and steps of agent work. A --status-size disc (22px; ToolChips set 18px) with a 12px glyph: a dashed ring holding an optional number, a spinning arc, ! on an attention disc, a check on a success disc, a cross on a danger disc, a small square in an outlined ring and a dashed ring with a dash. The check and cross draw themselves only after the state changes, never on first render, and reduced motion or keyboard modality make the draw instant. Filled discs keep a transparent border, so forced colors still outline them. A span that accepts no other attributes and is not interactive; pair it with text that states the status.

props.name: size
props.note: Glyph 10, 13 or 16 px in an 18, 24 or 30 px tile.

props.name: working
props.note: Turns the star a quarter step on a loop (--motion-loop-turn) while the assistant works. Application or OS reduced motion holds it still.

props.name: label
props.note: Accessible name. Without one the mark is decorative and aria-hidden; with one it is an img.

support.purpose: The eight-point star that marks AI presence: --ai on an --ai-soft tile. Use it only where the assistant acts or produced the content, never on content it did not produce. The star is symmetric, so it never rests tilted. ThinkingIndicator and ThinkingState draw it at xs. A span that accepts no other attributes.

props.name: state
props.note: idle, running, needs-you, completed, failed or stopped. Default words: جاهز / Ready, يعمل / Working, بانتظارك / Needs you, اكتمل / Done, تعثّر / Failed and أُوقف / Stopped, chosen by provider direction. Colors: neutral fill, AI, attention, success, danger and a neutral outline.

props.name: label
props.note: Replaces the default word, for example the feminine اكتملت when the subject is feminine.

props.name: elapsed
props.note: Seconds, shown after the word as ٦ث / 6s, ١د ١٢ث / 1m 12s or ١س ٢د / 1h 2m with digits from config.numerals, in a fixed ch width. Update it at most once per second; it is never announced.

support.purpose: The single place a pattern names its state, with one vocabulary across every pattern. The word is real text and the dot decorative. It pings once when the state changes into needs-you, never on mount. Amber is reserved for needs-you. Not a live region: the pattern announces transitions in its own polite status. A span that accepts no other attributes.

props.name: children
props.note: On paper by default: what the assistant produced or proposes.

props.name: header
props.note: Sits on the tray above the paper: the AI mark, the task and the status pill.

props.name: footer
props.note: Sits on the tray below the paper: meta and decisions, spread to either end.

props.name: paper
props.note: False puts the children straight on the tray, with no paper.

support.purpose: The tray and paper composition: --surface-tray with --tray-pad around paper (--surface, --radius-paper, --shadow-paper and --paper-padding-*), with concentric corners. Never nest a tray inside a tray or a card inside a card. Accepts native div attributes, className, style and ref.

props.name: seconds
props.note: Whole seconds to count down from. Remount with a new key to restart.

props.name: onComplete
props.note: Called once, at zero.

props.name: paused
props.note: Stops the one-second timer; it resumes from the time left. Owners pause while the pointer is over them or focus is inside.

props.name: label
props.note: The sentence around the formatted time left; defaults to خلال {t} / in {t}.

props.name: announcement
props.note: Polite announces label(total) once, set after mount; the ticking label is aria-hidden and never announced. Use off when the owner pattern announces it.

support.purpose: A ring and a label for an auto-start or undo window, a real UI affordance the host opted into. The ring drains a step each second; reduced motion makes each step instant. Unmount clears the timer. A span that accepts no other attributes.

useReducedMotion(): boolean. True when config.reducedMotion is set or the OS prefers reduced motion, and it follows changes to the OS setting. Use it for cosmetic timers and scripted demos instead of re-implementing the check.

props.name: status
props.note: Running reads يفكّر and shimmers with the time in the header; completed reads «فكّر لمدة ٦ث». Stopped reads «أُوقف بعد ٦ث» and failed «تعثّر بعد ٦ث» (the bare word when there is no time), and their thread stays still instead of closing into the solid line that means done. The label is the one sentence announced, never the time.

props.name: elapsed
props.note: Seconds, shown in the header while running in a fixed width and never announced. Update it at most once per second. Completed uses it in the header's label, never in the status.

props.name: sources
props.note: After «بحث في», the first three as chips and then a button, «+٢», that carries aria-expanded and is named «+٢ عرض كل المصادر» (what it shows, then showAll as hidden text). It shows the rest and then reads «عرض أقل»; focus stays on it. A chip among the first three that arrives after mount fades in once; the revealed ones never do.

props.name: steps
props.type: readonly { id: string; label: string; state: "pending" | "running" | "completed" }[]
props.note: Each step has a status icon, its label (shimmering while running) and a hidden state word.

props.name: open
props.note: Controls the disclosure; pair it with onOpenChange. Without it the panel starts open while running and closed once completed.

props.name: labels
props.note: Replaces any built-in text, among it showAll and showFewer, the words of the sources button.

props.name: announcement
props.note: Polite renders one status region holding «يفكّر» while running and «فكّر» once done, never the time; off renders none, for an owner pattern that announces. Cited answer runs it off.

support.purpose: The evidence while an answer is prepared: one line with the AI mark, the label, the time and a chevron, and under it what was searched, the steps and the thread. Built on the disclosure rules of ThinkingState (a closed panel is hidden and inert at once, and collapsing returns focus to the trigger unless the person moved it), with ThinkingIndicator's rule of one stable announced label. Use it inside Cited answer; a standalone page for it is not part of the navigation.

props.name: feedback
props.note: The rating. Without it the bar keeps its own.

props.name: reason
props.note: The reason picked for a "down" rating: inaccurate, wrong-source, too-long or outdated. Without it the bar keeps its own.

props.name: onFeedbackChange
props.note: Helpful and not helpful are aria-pressed toggles; pressing the one that is on calls it with null. A "down" offers the four reasons as buttons, each calling it with ("down", reason).

props.name: onCopy
props.note: The host copies the text. The copied label stays visible for two seconds once the promise resolves; the copy button keeps its name. The word stays mounted with only its visibility toggled so the buttons never shift. announcement controls its live semantics. A rejection shows nothing, and a result after unmount is ignored.

props.name: onCopyAnnouncement
props.note: Receives an empty string when a copy starts, then the localized copied label only after the copy succeeds while mounted. Pair with announcement="off" to reuse the owner’s live region. Rejected copies and results after unmount do not report success.

props.name: labels
props.note: Replaces any built-in text.

props.name: announcement
props.note: Speak successful copy feedback locally by default. Set off and handle onCopyAnnouncement to reuse a containing pattern’s live region; the visible confirmation is unchanged.

support.purpose: Copy, regenerate, helpful and not helpful (with reasons) as quiet icon buttons in a named group. Each button shows only when its handler exists. Standalone copy confirmation is polite by default; containing patterns set announcement="off" and route onCopyAnnouncement into their one region. A thumb that is on is filled, so color is not the only signal.

props.name: items
props.note: Renders nothing when empty.

props.name: onSelect
props.note: The person picked a question; the host asks it.

props.name: label
props.note: The list's visible name and accessible name; «أسئلة تالية» / Next questions by default.

support.purpose: Suggested next questions as a named list of buttons, each one calling onSelect with its id.

props.name: segments
props.note: The passage as runs of same, insert and delete text. A change is a run of consecutive inserts and deletes, keyed by its first segment's id.

props.name: decisions
props.note: Keyed by change id. A decided change keeps both sides, the side that lost faded and struck through, so it can still be found and changed.

props.name: onDecisionsChange
props.note: Called with the whole next map when a change is accepted or rejected; choosing a change's current decision again calls nothing.

props.name: labels
props.note: accept, reject, change(removed, added), which names each group, and shortcut(key), which describes each button.

support.purpose: Tracked changes in running text: a deletion struck through on the danger tint and an insertion underlined on the success tint. Each change is a focusable group named by what it does, with its own accept (Y) and reject (N) toggle buttons in a small bar that shows while focus is in it. Y and N match event.code, so an Arabic layout works, and never act on a repeat, with Ctrl, Meta or Alt, or in a text field.

props.name: status
props.note: queued shows a still atmospheric canvas; weaving brings the whole picture into focus with supplied progress, or keeps it soft while progress is unknown; completed resolves the picture sharply; failed holds the frame where it stopped and pauses the light.

props.name: alt
props.note: Names the whole box as one image (role=img). Everything inside it is decoration and hidden from assistive technology.

props.name: src
props.note: The preview picture, as the host gives it. Without one the canvas shows soft atmospheric light.

props.name: progress
props.note: Actual host progress from 0 to 100. The reveal follows it; omit it or pass null while it is unknown. The pattern that owns the canvas exposes the value in its own progressbar.

support.purpose: A whole-image preview that comes into focus with actual host progress, with soft atmospheric light while weaving and a crisp completion. Unknown progress keeps the preview soft until the host completes the job; the light never implies a percentage. Failure holds the current preview and pauses the light. Under reduced motion nothing loops: a still thread shows while waiting for a picture, and the whole picture fades in over 200 ms. It is sized by its container, 3:2 unless the --weave-ratio custom property says otherwise. For the AI mark's work, never for content the assistant did not produce.

conventions.defaults: Default fields contain literal JSON scalars or descriptive expressions. The string undefined means omitted/no default, not a string value to pass. configuration.defaults contains the actual literal defaultConfig.
conventions.authority: Public source/types win; inherited prop details depend on the installed React/Radix versions. Workbench editing limits are not public API limits.
conventions.kinds: AI families carry a kind. pattern: a complete job with its states, events and parts. screen: a composition shell that arranges patterns. part: a piece patterns are built on, also usable alone. content: a block that shows supplied text. A pattern's parts lists registry ids (components or support entries) and a part's usedBy lists the patterns that name it; an empty usedBy means no pattern is built on it. Other families have no kind.
conventions.overlayDependencies: Use one resolved @radix-ui/react-dismissable-layer 1.2.1 and @radix-ui/react-focus-scope 1.3.1; source-copy hosts preserve overrides from ai/README.md. @radix-ui/react-popper 1.4.0 supplies Tooltip positioning.
conventions.chartDependencies: Verified Recharts 3.10.1, React/React DOM 19.3.0 and react-is 19.3.0. Use a matching react-is version in source-copy hosts.
conventions.datePickerDependencies: Verified @daypicker/react 10.0.2 (React >=16.8, Gregorian Arabic/English locale labels) and @radix-ui/react-popover 1.3.1 (React 19 compatible); one shared focus-scope 1.3.1 and dismissable-layer 1.2.1. No upstream CSS required; Tiraz styles scoped .rdp-* in components.css.
